title.zh: 腔体状态：同配方也会慢慢漂
title.en: Chamber state: the same recipe can drift gradually

subtitle.zh: 清腔 / Seasoning / 腔壁膜层 / 耗材寿命
subtitle.en: Chamber cleaning / seasoning / wall film / consumable lifetime

body.zh: 湿清或换件；去除沉积；更换耗材
body.en: Wet clean or replace parts Remove deposits Replace consumables

body.zh: Seasoning；建立稳定；腔壁状态
body.en: Seasoning Establish a stable chamber-wall condition

body.zh: 早期晶圆确认；关注首片；与片间趋势
body.en: Verify early wafers Monitor the first wafer and wafer-to-wafer trends

body.zh: 生产沉积累积；腔壁膜层；逐渐增厚
body.en: Production deposit accumulation Chamber-wall film gradually thickens

body.zh: 结果逐渐漂移；同配方下；片间性能漂移
body.en: Results gradually drift Under the same recipe, wafer-to-wafer performance drifts

body.zh: 清洁或维护；恢复初始状态；进入新循环
body.en: Cleaning or maintenance Restore the initial state and begin a new cycle

body.zh: 清腔后；膜厚/刻蚀分布；腔壁干净；边界条件可控
body.en: After cleaning Film-thickness / etch distribution Clean chamber walls and controlled boundary conditions

body.zh: 稳定区；膜厚/刻蚀分布；形成稳定腔壁膜层；工艺窗口稳定
body.en: Stable regime Film-thickness / etch distribution A stable wall film forms and the process window stabilizes

body.zh: 累积后；膜厚/刻蚀分布；沉积持续累积；腔体边界发生变化
body.en: After accumulation Film-thickness / etch distribution Deposits continue to accumulate and chamber boundaries change

body.zh: 清洁降低沉积与颗粒 ↔ 同时重置腔壁状态
body.en: Cleaning reduces deposits and particles ↔ also resets wall conditions

body.zh: 腔壁温度；•影响膜层沉积/去除；•温度不均会改变边缘状态
body.en: Chamber-wall temperature • Affect film deposition / removal • Temperature nonuniformity changes edge conditions

body.zh: Seasoning条件；•气体种类与流量；•时间与功率设定；•决定腔壁初始膜层特性
body.en: Seasoning conditions • Gas species and flow • Time and power settings • Determine initial wall-film properties

body.zh: 累计片数或等离子时间；•随片数膜层逐渐变化；•影响刻蚀速率与均匀性；• 存在漂移趋势
body.en: Cumulative wafer count or plasma time • Film evolves with wafer count • Affects etch rate and uniformity • A drift trend exists

body.zh: Kit与聚焦环寿命；•耗材磨损/沉积改变间隙；•影响气流与电场分布；• 寿命接近时更易漂移
body.en: Kit and focus-ring lifetime • Wear / deposits change gaps • Affect gas flow and electric-field distribution • Drift becomes more likely near end of life

body.zh: 典型风险；First-wafer；effect
body.en: Typical risks First-wafer effect

body.zh: 清腔后；速率漂移
body.en: After cleaning, etch rate drifts

body.zh: 腔间匹配差
body.en: Poor chamber matching

body.zh: 颗粒突增
body.en: Particle spike

body.zh: 异常不应自动；触发配方修改
body.en: An abnormality should not automatically trigger a recipe change

body.zh: 量测反馈：；OES与Endpoint/FDC / 片序与PM记录；OES；Endpoint；FDC；片序与PM记录
body.en: Metrology feedback: OES and endpoint / FDC / wafer sequence and PM records OES Endpoint FDC Wafer sequence and PM records
